purpose: Secure approval for a monthly facility stock-out verification rule.
readerAction: Approve the rule and assign district pharmacy managers as owners.
evidence: 11 facilities reported at least one stock-out between April and June 2026.
The median duration was 6 days, with a range of 1 to 19 days.
Proposed operating rule: district pharmacy managers verify facility reports by the fifth working day of each month.
Operational rationale: the fixed deadline allows the district team to identify missing submissions and correct stock records before the monthly review.
constraints: Do not invent costs, staffing levels, implementation dates, organisations or effect estimates.
Use direct UK English and return only the brief.
